[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Relations, reveal, and grouping as Artifacts contract features[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Hierarchy, family, and link relations are declared contract facts [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]rendered by one host-owned relation panel on every Artifacts pane; [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]reveal is a reversible lens that never destroys a composed query; [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and every pane's grouping runs on the one shared GroupFoldRegistry [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]with collapsed banners as first-class navigation targets. A sidecar[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]that names a property gets jumpers and grouping without shipping [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]code.[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Relations and grouping become declared contract facts[/bold #D7AFFF]         [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]vocabulary[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]vocabulary: replace the PaneRelationDecl/PaneGroupingDecl placeholders [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]with real records, derive RELATIONS and GROUPING from named rules, add [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the additive ref.relations and ref.grouping declaration blocks, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]surface both in the pane explainer.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]The host-owned relation index and its built-in sources[/bold #D7AFFF]        [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]index[dim] · [dim][/dim]after vocabulary[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]index: build one immutable per-snapshot RelationIndex over the three [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]primitives with derived inverses, cycle detection, and dangling [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]diagnostics, then supply it from built-in sources for all five panes [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]plus a generic declared-property source.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]One host-owned relation panel and generalized jumpers[/bold #D7AFFF]         [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]panel[dim] · [dim][/dim]after index[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]panel: replace AncestorsChildrenPanel with a shell-owned RelationPanel, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]generalize the ancestor/child/sibling key modes off Patch onto any pane [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]with the RELATIONS capability, and route cross-pane edges through the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]shared entry request.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Reveal as a reversible lens[/bold #D7AFFF]                                   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]reveal[dim] · [dim][/dim]after panel[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]reveal: keep the query rewrite as the mechanism but wrap it in a lens [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]record with a visible return affordance, generalize the hard-coded Patch[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]rewrite terms onto the contract, and make dangling targets diagnostics [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]instead of pane invalidations.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Every pane's grouping on the shared fold registry[/bold #D7AFFF]             [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]grouping[dim] · [dim][/dim]after vocabulary[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]grouping: give every pane a GroupFoldRegistry, convert the four panes [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]that render non-selectable headers into foldable banners that are [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]first-class navigation and jump targets, and migrate Beads off its [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]inverted expanded-epic set.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Conformance, docs, and the relation performance gate[/bold #D7AFFF]          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]conform[dim] · [dim][/dim]after reveal, grouping[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]conform: extend the conformance harness and the synthetic third-party [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]fixture with relation and grouping checks, document the relation and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]banner grammar, and hold the navigation performance gate on every [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]converted pane.[/#D7D7AF]
